age.evidence: All mice used were C57Bl6/J and at least 12 weeks of age, but no more than 5 months, at the time of surgery.

sex.evidence: female mice performed fewer trials on DOI compared to saline (Figure 1D; Wilcoxon signed rank test, p = 0.011, n = 12), whereas male mice did not show a significant difference (Figure 1D; Wilcoxon signed rank test, p = 0.39, n = 10).

dosing.evidence: (±)-DOI hydrochloride (DOI) (Sigma-Aldrich, #D101) was dissolved in sterile physiological saline and injected at a fixed volume of 5 mL/kg at a dose of 3 mg/kg.

group_housing.evidence: Animals were group housed on a reverse 12:12 h light cycle.

day_night_flipped.evidence: Animals were group housed on a reverse 12:12 h light cycle. All behavioral testing was performed during the dark cycle.

assays.assay_description: Two-alternative choice odor navigation task in a custom arena: mice poke an initiation port, then navigate toward a turbulent odor gradient (2-PE 0.001%) emanating from the left or right side to receive a water reward. 10% odor-omission trials. 40-min sessions. DOI (3 mg/kg) or saline i.p. 5 min before session, crossover design. Measures: accuracy, trial counts, trial/ITI duration, reward port duration, movement speed (DLC tracking), sniff frequency (thermistor), HTR rate and spatial distribution.

application_type.evidence: Drugs were administered IP 5 min prior to behavioral testing.

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were trained first to associate an initiation port, left reward port, and right reward port in an alternating pattern with a water reward... they graduated onto the odor navigation task.

setup_restrain.evidence: freely moving mice; an overhead camera tracked movement in real-time.

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were given ad libitum unless otherwise specified for water restriction.

water_restriction.evidence: Mice were water restricted and maintained at a minimum of 80% baseline weight for training and experiments.

time_to_assay.evidence: Mice were then administered 3 mg/kg DOI or saline then placed into the task 5 min later.

sample_size.evidence: Wilcoxon signed rank test, p = 0.024, n = 22; female n = 12, male n = 10 (crossover design).

outcomes.summary: Acute DOI (3 mg/kg, i.p.) decreased olfactory search accuracy, reduced the number of trials completed (driven by females), increased trial duration and reward-port dwell time, decreased movement speed, and increased sniff frequency across trial types and ITI. HTRs were spatially clustered near odor ports rather than uniformly distributed.
outcomes.statistics: Accuracy: Wilcoxon signed rank, p = 0.024, n = 22; Trials completed: p = 0.011 (females p = 0.011, males p = 0.39); Reward port duration: p = 0.002; Trial duration odor: p < 0.001; Speed within trial: p = 0.011; Speed ITI: p = 0.036; Sniff frequency: Fisher-Pitman Z = 24.9, p < 0.001; HTR X-coord spatial: permutation p < 0.001.
outcomes.evidence: Mice more often navigated to the incorrect side of the arena in the DOI condition (p = 0.024)... sniff frequency was higher in DOI sessions (Z = 24.9, p < 0.001)... DOI decreased movement speed.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Accuracy, trials completed, initiation repokes, reward port duration (correct/incorrect), trial duration, ITI duration, movement speed, sniff frequency, occupancy, HTR rate/location.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: we quantified accuracy in 5 min time bins... grand mean accuracy in the task binned in 5 min intervals.

B4_ethological.evidence: Sniff frequency analyzed as active sampling behavior; HTRs scored (HTR explicitly listed as not ethological in rubric, but sniffing as natural active sensing is measured here).

B5_social.evidence: Mice tested individually; no social construct.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Mice were trained until they performed at 85% accuracy... two-alternative choice odor navigation task requiring learned stimulus-reward association.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: DeepLabCut used for pose tracking (position keypoints). KPMoSeq mentioned in methods but no behavioral syllable results are reported in this paper; main analyses are position-based.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Only univariate tests (Wilcoxon, Fisher-Pitman, permutation); no PCA/UMAP/clustering reported.

E1_environment_type.evidence: Custom two-alternative choice olfactory arena with initiation and reward ports — a standard behavioral apparatus.

E2_shelter.evidence: No shelter/refuge described in the arena.

E3_bedding.evidence: No bedding described in testing arena.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in testing apparatus.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects in testing apparatus.

E6_spatial.evidence: Single open arena with initiation port and left/right virtual quadrants for the odor source; no physical partitions described.

E8_food_water.evidence: Water reward delivered at reward ports during the session (6-8 µL per poke).

D1_continuity.evidence: Mice were assigned to start in the DOI or saline condition then crossed over into the other condition at least 1 week later — two recorded sessions per mouse.

D2_session_duration.evidence: Sessions were at a fixed duration of 40 min.

D3_recording_days.evidence: DOI session and saline session, crossover ≥1 week apart = 2 recording days for this assay.

D4_baseline.evidence: Both crossover sessions involve drug or vehicle administration; no pre-drug baseline session data reported as comparison.

D5_followup.evidence: Testing only 5 min after injection; no ≥24h post-acute follow-up reported.

judge_notes: Single assay: the olfactory search task. HTR scoring, sniff analysis, occupancy, and DLC speed are all derived from the same recording session of the same paradigm — not separate assays.
B4 ethological: scored Yes following glm — sniffing is directly measured as a natural active-sensing behavior. HTR alone would not count per rubric.

B7 automated classification: scored 0 — DeepLabCut is explicitly listed in the rubric as position-tracking (score 0). KPMoSeq is mentioned in methods but no syllable-based result is reported in the paper's results.
E6 spatial: scored 0 — the arena is a single open space with virtual left/right quadrants; no physical partitions described.
Water restriction = 'before' (chronic restriction maintained for training/testing); food = 'during' (food not in apparatus, ad lib otherwise).
D4 baseline: scored 0 — the crossover design uses saline as a within-subject control session, not a pre-drug baseline within the same assay/environment before drug administration.
